facts.fact: Angola's telecommunications ministry (MINTTICS) put its draft Proposta de Lei sobre a Inteligencia Artificial out for public consultation on its consultation portal, which on 2026-08-27 showed 18 contributions from companies, 18 from specialists and 5 from the general public (the page is undated, so the date is the retrieval date).
